scripts.dev: concurrently --names server,client --prefix-colors green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.lint: concurrently --names server,client --prefix-colors green,cyan "npm --prefix server run lint" "npm --prefix client run lint"
scripts.lint:fix: concurrently --names server,client --prefix-colors green,cyan "npm run lint:fix:server" "npm run lint:fix:client"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
